title: My Development Tool Belt
author: Patient-Sprinkles920
selftext:
I use Unity to pull it altogether, Claude writes the C# (and taught me how to use Unity), Grok Imagine does most of the artwork, I provide the design, Claude steering and testing. I estimate I put in close to 1,000 hours into my first game. I am not totally happy with it but I learned a ton creating it. No downloads yet. I would love your thoughts on the look and feel and what I could do better. Thanks.

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oceanstudios.blazesoceanquest&pcampaignid=web\_share](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oceanstudios.blazesoceanquest&pcampaignid=web_share)
